correctness.rationale: For any selected pivots S, Sherman–Morrison gives residual D_{S^c}+(b^{-1}+sum_{i in S}d_i^{-1})^{-1}11^T. The exceptional index excluded/included fixes sum=k versus k-1+a^{-1}, hence exactly the event-based trace pair T0,T1. At j previous normal pivots, residual-diagonal sampling avoids exceptional with factor (n-1-j)(1+u_j)/[(n-1-j)(1+u_j)+a+u_j], u_j=(b^{-1}+j)^{-1}; multiplication is p0. Algebra yields T0-T1=(a-1)[1-(n-k)/((a x+1)(x+1))], x=b^{-1}+k-1. Greedy picks exception first and gives T1; expected random minus greedy=p0(T0-T1); the exact boundary is sharp and globally minimizes trace among two subset types. For n=t^3,a=t,b=t²,k=1: greedy~t^4, randomized~2t^3, ratio~t/2 while every correlation tends uniformly one and diagonal ratio tends one. Independently computed exact SymPy Schur complements for every k-subset with n=5,7 and two rational (a,b) pairs; all matched formulas. Finite checks are not proof of asymptotics.
